title: electricLoad operation
description: Shaft sink / electrical generator. Hardware-free apart from the generator efficiency, and it has no stream ports. The shaft power W_shaft is NOT authored here — it arrives over an energy wire from a turbine or any other work producer, via energyInputs ( { from <unit>.shaft; kind work; target W_shaft; } ). The electrical power shipped to the grid (eta * W_shaft) and the dissipated losses ((1-eta) * W_shaft) are RESULTS. See docs/ai/energy.md; tutorials rankine01_water, combined01_brayton_rankine, proxy01_gas_loop.

eta.title: Generator efficiency
eta.description: Shaft-to-electrical efficiency (0 < eta <= 1); default 1.0. The (1-eta) fraction is dissipated as heat and reported as the W_losses KPI.
